title: Multiparametric MRI-based radiomics combined with deep learning for preoperative risk stratification of endometrial carcinoma.
summary: The combined model reports validation AUC 0.891 and related discrimination metrics.
ai_technology: Combined MRI radiomics, deep-learning, clinical, and semantic features were modeled for endometrial-cancer risk
organization: Department of Radiology, The First People’s Hospital of Qinzhou, China; Department of Medical Imaging, Jinjiang Municipal Hospital, China; Department of Radiology, Guigang City People’s Hospital, China; Department of Radiology, Affiliated Hospital of Youjiang Medical University for Nationalities, China

evidence.tested: The combined model reports validation AUC 0.891 and related discrimination metrics. Evaluation: Validation-set performance was reported; the relevant MRI cohort and reference standard need cautious interpretation.
evidence.unknown: The reported AUC is cohort- and reference-standard-specific; prospective clinical utility is not established.
evidence.ai_role: Combined MRI radiomics, deep-learning, clinical, and semantic features were modeled for endometrial-cancer risk.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
